messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment started: service=runtime-serve, image=runtime:v2.3.7, rollout=canary(10%). Logs: https://deploys.redwood.dev/r/1791234567

sam: saw a short spike in post-deploy synthetic failures from kvcache probe ~2m after canary start. 14 failures, all from synthetic-KV-prefix probe. alert link: https://alerts.redwood.dev/INC-1791

marta: looking at the canary pods, CPU/mem all normal. KV cache hit-rate metric shows a few NaNs around that window. dashboard: https://metrics.redwood.dev/d/kvcache

elaine: quick check — real traffic traces look fine, user-facing latencies unchanged. I suspect exporter/aggregation noise rather than model runtime problem.

chris: agree with @elaine. Can we re-run the synthetic probe against the same canary instance to confirm? Sam, can you paste the probe command?

sam: re-run command I used: ```./scripts/smoke_kvprobe.sh --target http://canary-1.runtime.svc:8080 --keys 1000 --pattern prefix:test```

deploy-bot: Running smoke job kvcache-smoke-1791234567 on canary-1 (started)

oncall-bot: Synthetic probe results: 3m window, 0 failures on re-run, avg latency 42ms. (job: kvcache-smoke-1791234567)

marta: That looks like a false positive spike from the exporter. I see matching timestamps where our metric pipeline dropped a partition and produced NaNs from prom-aggregator-3.

chris: Recommended action: do NOT rollback. Keep canary at 10% for another 20m and increase synthetic sampling rate x2 to be safe. Also pin the canary image for the rest of the rollout until we finish the follow-up. @release-manager please pin. :thumbsup:

release-manager: Pinned traffic: rolling policy set to manual; canary image runtime:v2.3.7 pinned at 10%. Will not auto-increment. Noted follow-up ticket INF-2345 to investigate prom-aggregator partitions.

elaine: created a short-run remediation: adjust synthetic probe threshold to ignore NaNs and treat as non-failure if downstream telemetry missing. Patch submitted: https://git.redwood.dev/infra/synthetics/merge/456

sam: re-run of the full post-deploy smoke-suite passed (all checks green). Will monitor for next 30m then proceed to 50% if still clean.

marta: filed INF-2345 with logs + grafana snapshots. Assigning to @chris and @infra-team.

chris: sounds good. If anything else flaps we'll rollback, but current evidence points to tooling noise. Thanks everyone. :party_parrot: 

deploy-bot: Canary healthcheck: healthy=5/5, errors=0, duration=28m. Next step: await manual promotion to 50% or further instructions.

oncall-bot: Note: incident alert suppressed for INC-1791 as per runbook; suppression expires in 40m.
